tips.body: Use 'Start VM in case of danger' to automatically start the VIRTUAL Machining Center or SIMULATION Center if any checked collision occurs.

tips.title: Define start point for machining operation
tips.body: Use 'Set start point in cycle' to manually define the start point for a machining operation.

tips.title: Enable CFG parameter in cycle
tips.body: Use 'CFG parameter enable' to enable a specific CFG parameter used in the cycle.

tips.title: Define precise starting point for machining
tips.body: Use 'CFG parameter point' to define the exact starting point for the machining operation.

tips.title: Calculate coordinates in job frame
tips.body: Use 'Calculate to frame coordinates' to convert entered X, Y, Z values to the job frame.

tips.title: Predefine NC code sequence for measuring
tips.body: Use 'New NC Event' to create a predefined NC code sequence for measuring purposes.

tips.title: Use text file for NC code sequence
tips.body: Use 'New NC event from text file' to use a predefined NC code sequence from a text file.

tips.title: Prepare VT XML for AUTOMATION Center
tips.body: Use 'Prepare VT XML for AC' to create a *.vtx Virtual Tool file with XML structures for the AUTOMATION Center.

tips.title: Update all tools from external database
tips.body: Use 'Update all tools' to update the linked tool with data from the external tool database.

tips.title: Unlink all tools from external database
tips.body: Use 'Unlink all tools' to unlink all tools from the external tool database.

tips.title: Prepare VT XML for AC
tips.body: Supplements *.vtx from Virtual Tool with data structures for processing in AUTOMATION Center.

tips.title: Run hole feature recognition process
tips.body: Creates drilling jobs by assigning macros.

tips.title: Prepare tools and jobs for minimal tool length (Reduce)
tips.body: Activates Reduce option in hyperMILL® to set specified imaginary tool length for all or collision-warning jobs.

tips.title: Recalculate jobs after reducing tool length
tips.body: Assigns minimum projection length to imaginary tools in recalculated jobs.

tips.title: Prepare tools and jobs for minimal tool length (Deactivate Reduce)
tips.body: Deactivates Reduce option to restore original tool lengths.

tips.title: Transfer minimal tool length to job CGF
tips.body: Transfers calculated minimum possible tool length to a job CFG parameter.

tips.title: Optimize tools (VT)
tips.body: Searches for a suitable tool from the tool database using *.vtx extended for AUTOMATION Center.

tips.title: Delete unnecessary data
tips.body: Removes data no longer required after processing.

tips.title: Optimize tool projection length to avoid collisions
tips.body: Use hyperMILL → Setup → Settings in Database to enter a user database project with a macro database and Virtual Tool. Run Prepare VT XML for AC, then Prepare tools and jobs for minimal tool length by setting the Reduce option and specifying an imaginary tool length.

tips.title: Adjust tools to find the best suited tool
tips.body: Use hyperMILL → Tool → Adjust tools, specifying the original tool number, depot, and whether a pre-calculation should be performed. Enter up to ten optional replacement tools.

tips.title: Calculate machining time for jobs and joblists
tips.body: Use hyperMILL → Machining time → Calculate machining time, entering the acceleration of the machine, maximum feedrate, tool change time, and a time adjust factor. Select a joblist to calculate the theoretical machining time.

tips.title: Delete machining time from job comments
tips.body: Use hyperMILL → Machining time → Delete machining time to remove a previously inserted machining time by deleting the comment.

tips.title: Precalculate machining time for tool-related calculations
tips.body: Use hyperMILL → Machining time → Precalculate machining time, entering the acceleration of the machine, maximum feedrate, tool change time, and a time adjust factor. Select a joblist to calculate tool-related machining time.

tips.title: Write Vericut simulation data to a file
tips.body: Use hyperMILL → External automation → Write Vericut simulation data, selecting a joblist and specifying the target path for the output file.

tips.title: Write a TIM file for Promot manufacturer
tips.body: Use hyperMILL → External automation → Write TIM file, selecting a joblist and specifying the target path for the output file.

tips.title: Output machining times to a CSV file
tips.body: Use hyperMILL → External automation → Write time CSV file, specifying the separator and target path for the output file.

tips.title: Execute an external application
tips.body: Use hyperMILL → External automation → Execute external application, entering the folder and filename of the external application.

tips.title: Select a VBS script folder
tips.body: Use hyperMILL → External automation → Choose VBS script folder to select the storage location for VBS scripts in the Default folder for the AUTOMATION Center.

tips.title: Execute a VBS script
tips.body: Use hyperMILL → External automation → Execute VBS script to run an externally generated script in VBScript, selecting the storage location of the VBS scripts.

tips.title: Check script variable conditions
tips.body: Use commands to check whether a script variable is <, >, = or ≠ to a value.

tips.title: Define external application for errors
tips.body: Set up an external application to handle errors during script execution.

tips.title: Call CAD commands from script
tips.body: Use the 'CAD command' function to execute specific CAD operations via script.

tips.title: Write project to ZIP file
tips.body: Export a hyperMILL® project to a ZIP file for backup or transfer.

tips.title: Read project from ZIP file
tips.body: Import a hyperMILL® project from a previously exported ZIP file.

tips.title: Synchronize runtime scripts
tips.body: Keep local and global runtime scripts in sync to avoid discrepancies.

tips.title: Create Opticam start hole
tips.body: Generate an Opticam start hole for wire eroding operations.

tips.title: Execute hyperMILL® Create NC file function
tips.body: Generate an NC file for the current joblist or all joblists.

tips.title: Run hyperVIEW report
tips.body: Generate and view a hyperVIEW report for the selected joblist.

tips.title: Close web browser displaying report
tips.body: Terminate the web browser process used to display a hyperVIEW report.

tips.title: Print file
tips.body: Output a file to the default printer.

tips.title: Save hyperMILL® project
tips.body: Export the current hyperMILL® project to a file.

tips.title: Save hyperMILL® project as
tips.body: Export the current hyperMILL® project to a file with a specified format and location.

tips.title: Add user name to file path
tips.body: Insert the current user name into the file path when saving a project.

tips.title: Close current document and program window
tips.body: Terminate the current hyperMILL® document and its associated program window.

tips.title: Enter the name of the Excel worksheet.
tips.body: Sheet name: [name]

tips.title: Check whether a script variable is <, >, = or ≠ to a value.
tips.body: Condition: [variable] <, >, =, ≠ [value]

tips.title: Insert an image from an image file into an Excel file.
tips.body: Cell address for image (start): [cell], Cell address for image (end): [cell]

tips.title: Stop when the first row is empty.
tips.body: Stop when the first row is empty: [yes/no]

tips.title: Search for a variable in Excel.
tips.body: Search text: [string], Search in column: [column]

tips.title: Read values from Excel file.
tips.body: Cell address for value: [cell]

tips.title: Determine the number of table rows filled with content.
tips.body: Amount of header lines: [number]

tips.title: Read multiple values from Excel file.
tips.body: Cell address: [cell], Default: [value]

tips.title: Transfer the content of Excel worksheets to a text file.
tips.body: Target folder: [folder], Target file: [file]

tips.title: Insert a new worksheet into an Excel file.
tips.body: Sheet name: [name]

tips.title: Select an Excel worksheet.
tips.body: Sheet name: [name]

tips.title: Copy first or selected Excel worksheet.
tips.body: Source sheet name: [name], Target sheet name: [name]

tips.title: Insert a new empty row.
tips.body: Address of new row: [cell], Copy cell attributes: [yes/no]

tips.title: Clear rows in Excel.
tips.body: Start row: [cell], End row: [cell]

tips.title: Select an Excel file for automation tasks
tips.body: Choose the appropriate Excel file from the folder or specify a file name.

tips.title: Specify the sheet name for data manipulation
tips.body: Enter the exact name of the Excel worksheet to be used.

tips.title: Set row index for data insertion or extraction
tips.body: Enter the row number where data should be inserted or extracted.

tips.title: Create a tool graphic from selected tool parameters
tips.body: Generate and save a tool graphic with specified dimensions, orientation, and render style.

tips.title: Manage bookmarks for saved views and settings
tips.body: Create, activate, delete, rename, or recapture bookmarks to save and recall specific view states.

tips.title: Read tag values from entities based on layer, color, and type
tips.body: Retrieve tag values for specified entities using layer, color, and type criteria.

tips.title: Transfer PMI information from imported CAD entities
tips.body: Use automation functions to transfer PMI (Product Manufacturing Information) data from CAD entities.
